# P35.13 — Provenance stamp, release.json, headers

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/295_P35.13__provenance-stamp-release-json-headers.md` (manifest row **295**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B; deps P35.12 + P34.17, gate `none`). **Requirement ids stamped:** **SIG-REL-009** (release stamp — owner; G3 §6.1/§6.2/§6.3); cited context: SIG-REL-001/002/003 (row 294 owns the identity fields this row renders), SIG-MEM-011 (the stamp is a live-state claim — every value comes from the descriptor), SIG-SEC-008 (the `X-SIG-Code`/image digest references are digest-pinned), SIG-REL-010 (P35.57's basis label + release serving this row extends). **Base:** `r11/P35.12-release-identity-v2-clock-guards` · **Live leg:** none — committed machinery only; the stamp/headers/`release.json` take effect on the next republish under that row's own authority (no hosted mutation by this row, OM-14/OM-20).

## What ships

- **`exports/src/exports/site_release.py`** (new) — the `sig.site-release/1` object (G3 §6.2): `label`, `publication_id`, `descriptor_sha256`, `as_of_world`, `as_of_belief`, `belief_pinned`, `spine_watermark`, `built_at`, `code {commit, url, repository}`, `versions`, `evaluation {status, deferral_refs}`, `disclosures`, `routes_sha256`, `integrity_manifest {path, sha256}` — every field derived from the validated v2 descriptor plus the manifest digest the build just computed; `validate_site_release` is fail-closed field validation.
- **`exports/src/exports/release.py`** — `build_release` emits `releases/<pub>/release.json` (the immutable namespace copy) and the release-tree root `release.json` (the `/release.json` the stamped pages' `describedby` resolves to — `PROTECTED_NAMES` already covers the name), validates the assembled document before writing it, and adds both paths to the emitted-date scan; `validate_release` cross-checks the site-release object against the descriptor field-by-field plus manifest digest and byte-identical copies, and fails a `release.json` on a non-v2 release; `load_mutable_stamp` projects the active release's site-release object into the §6.1 "latest view" stamp; `activate`/`rollback`/`clear_latest_pointer`/`apply_withdrawals`/`_emit_overlay`/`_entity_overlay` all thread the stamp and re-point the site-root copy with the latest pointer (removed when no release is current — never a stale one).
- **`exports/src/exports/release_pages.py`** — `release_stamp_view` + `_stamp_html`: `<meta name="sig-release" content="<label> <pub>">`, `<link rel="describedby" type="application/json">`, and the §6.1 footer pair — `fixed` variant ("This is the fixed copy of this release — cite this URL…") on `r/<pub>/`+`releases/<pub>/` pages, `latest` variant ("This is the latest view. Cite the fixed copy: /r/<pub>/…") on mutable pages. `release.json` joins the link-crawl `EXTERNAL_LINK_ROUTES`.
- **`exports/src/exports/published_record.py`** — bound records serialize the §6.1 provenance blocks: `release {label, publication_id, as_of_world}` and `licence {id, compartment}` — additive bound-view fields, `None` when unbound, never hashed into the projection.
- **`web/src/lib/release-stamp.ts`** (new) — reads the bound `sig.site-release/1` (`$SIG_RELEASE_JSON` → `$SIG_RELEASE_DIR/release.json` → `<exportDir>/release.json`), fail-closed validation (malformed = build error, never a degraded stamp); `fixtures` mode returns `null` — the honest dev-build state.
- **`web/`** — `BaseLayout.astro` emits the meta/link pair + the full §6.1 stamp on `chrome=full` pages (P34.17 interim sentence retained as the no-release fallback); `status.astro` answers currency with the stamped release; `print.astro` repeats the stamp in every print page footer; `dossier.ts`/`[slug].json.ts` JSON twins carry `release` + `licence` blocks. Zero client JS.
- **`api/src/api/basis_middleware.py`** — `X-SIG-Code: <commit12>` (first twelve hex of deploy-pinned `SIG_CODE_COMMIT`) and `X-SIG-Conf-Gen: <n>` (`SIG_CONF_GEN`) on **every** response — release-basis, live-spine and error bodies alike; absent env = absent header, never a placeholder. `/` + `/health` `release`/`code_commit`/`image` fields already shipped with P35.57 — this row populates the env they read.
- **`ops/`** — `sig-ops web-conf --release-label/--release-pub/--conf-gen` (or `SIG_LATEST_LABEL`/`SIG_LATEST_PUB`/`SIG_CONF_GEN`) generates `conf/release_headers.conf` (`add_header X-SIG-Release "<label> <pub>" always;` + `add_header X-SIG-Conf-Gen <n> always;`) — all-or-nothing, stale-fragment refusal, label/pub/gen grammar-checked so nothing smuggles directives into generated nginx; `ops/web/nginx.conf` glob-includes the dark fragment; `ops/Dockerfile` + `ops/gcp/materialize.sh` pin `SIG_CODE_COMMIT` (OCI `revision` label + env) from the same `HEAD` the image builds from; `ops/src/ops/release_serving.py` + `exports/cli.py` re-apply tombstones under the current release's stamp.

## Interim-text rule (G3 §6.1 NEW-2)

The stamp never claims a posture the descriptor does not evidence — three-layer overclaim tests: `tests/exports/test_site_release.py` (no "pinned" in stamp HTML for `belief_pinned: false`), `web/tests/unit/release-stamp.test.ts` (every printable field checked), and the S8-style `test_p35_13_built_site_carries_the_release_stamp` in `tests/e2e/test_composed_stack.py` (every `data-testid="release-stamp*"` element on the built site scanned).

## Boundaries

No production mutation; no hosted or remote state was written; activation/staging are registry-local; the republish that exercises the stamp is the publish rows' leg. `live_verification=false` per the ticket header. The `v/<pub>/`/`s/<pub>/` `release.json` copies ride those legs (J3 NEW-6 `withBase` refactor) — recorded in the run-ledger gap table.
